## A1

**What:** An agent instruction file exists

- **Dimension:** Guides
- **Evidence tier:** A (reference weight 10)
- **Detection:** Looks for a supported agent instruction file. (detector: `instruction-file-exists`)
- **Parameters:** None.
- **Applies when:** Always.
- **Supported agents:** Claude Code (`claude-code`), AGENTS.md / Codex (`agents-md`)
- **How to pass:** Add an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md at the repository root.

### Sources

- [Anthropic](<https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Create this file and add instructions that apply to anyone working on the project: build and test commands, coding standards, architectural decisions, naming conventions, and common workflows.

- [Google](<https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/best-practices>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Create a GEMINI.md or AGENTS.md file at your workspace root to outline specific directory standards, styling paradigms, test command parameters, and deprecation warnings.

- [xAI](<https://docs.x.ai/build/features/project-rules>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Put coding conventions, build and test commands, and architecture notes in an \`AGENTS.md\` at your repo root, and Grok follows them without being told each session.

## A2

**What:** The instruction file is short

- **Dimension:** Guides
- **Evidence tier:** A (reference weight 10)
- **Detection:** Compares the instruction file's line count with the configured limit. (detector: `instruction-file-length`)
- **Parameters:** Maximum instruction-file length: 200 lines. `{"max_lines":200}`
- **Applies when:** An instruction file is present. (`has-instruction-file`)
- **Supported agents:** Claude Code (`claude-code`), AGENTS.md / Codex (`agents-md`)
- **How to pass:** Move details the agent needs only sometimes into linked docs or skills, and keep the instruction file under the line cap.

### Sources

- [Anthropic](<https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Size: target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file. Longer files consume more context and reduce adherence.

- [Google](<https://codelabs.developers.google.com/harness-engineering-antigravity>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Keep always-on instructions in AGENTS.md short.

- [OpenAI](<https://openai.com/index/harness-engineering/>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: give Codex a map, not a 1,000-page instruction manual.

- [xAI](<https://docs.x.ai/build/features/project-rules>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: short, specific instructions are followed more reliably than long ones.

## C1

**What:** A test suite and a command to run it exist

- **Dimension:** Computational sensors
- **Evidence tier:** B (reference weight 7.5)
- **Detection:** Looks for test configuration and a command to run the test suite. (detector: `test-suite`)
- **Parameters:** None.

- **Supported agents:** Claude Code (`claude-code`), AGENTS.md / Codex (`agents-md`)

- [Google](<https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/best-practices>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Ensure your workspace directory has a test suite ready.

## D2

- **Dimension:** Enforcement
- **Evidence tier:** C (reference weight 5)
- **Detection:** Checks that a hook invokes a test or lint script that exists in the repository, rather than just mentioning a check-related keyword. (detector: `hook-runs-check`)

- **Supported agents:** Claude Code (`claude-code`), AGENTS.md / Codex (`agents-md`)

## F1

**What:** A pre-commit check exists

- **Dimension:** Timing
- **Evidence tier:** B (reference weight 7.5)
- **Detection:** Looks for configuration that runs checks before a commit. (detector: `pre-commit`)
- **Parameters:** None.
- **Applies when:** Always.
- **Supported agents:** Claude Code (`claude-code`), AGENTS.md / Codex (`agents-md`)
- **How to pass:** Run fast checks before each commit with husky, lefthook, or the pre-commit framework.

### Sources

- [martinfowler.com](<https://martinfowler.com/articles/harness-engineering.html>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: You want to have checks as far left in the path to production as possible, since the earlier you find issues, the cheaper they are to fix.

- [Google](<https://codelabs.developers.google.com/harness-engineering-antigravity>) — checked 2026-11-17.
  Recommendation: Instruct the agent to write and run tests before committing.
